testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-management.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23077 duplicate sales rep username is rejected

scenario.summary: With a sales rep already existing, the admin opens Add Sales Rep, enters that sales rep's username with valid other mandatory fields and clicks Save; the duplicate-username message is shown and nothing is saved.
steps: Open Add Sales Rep from the Sales Rep listing.
Enter the existing sales rep's username (@rep.userName) and valid store, email, first and last name.
assertions: Message 'This username already exists. Please enter a different username.' shown in red under Username
No second sales rep with that username is created
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 2 and answers in section 6.
FSD 'Create a Sales Rep': duplicate username validation as in the user module.
The test case's example username is not used: the existing sales rep comes from SALES_REP_OF_STORE (created per test).
Expected text from the test case; the FSD only refers to the user module's validations (expected-output, to confirm on the page).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
